name: mempalace:doctor
desc: Report which MemPalace will actually answer on this machine — resolved path, interpreter and version behind every MemPalace command and every CLI's memory-server registration. Exits non-zero on divergence (spec 0108).

name: mempalace:repair
desc: Repair the residue left by an interrupted MemPalace switch (spec 0165): an assistant whose configuration does not parse as JSON, or whose mempalace registration matches neither the http nor the stdio shape. With no flag, reports each affected assistant, its config path, whether a timestamped backup exists, and the available actions. The repair verbs need the separator (task mempalace:repair -- [--restore-backup | --reset-none]): --restore-backup restores the most recent usable backup, --reset-none removes the mempalace registration. Restores recognisability only — never registers anyone for http, never places the bearer token in argv.

name: mempalace:rotate-token
desc: Rotate the shared MemPalace MCP HTTP daemon bearer token (spec 0176). Mints a new token, replaces the daemon process, purges stale backups, and re-registers every assistant.

name: mempalace:status
desc: Report the shared MemPalace MCP HTTP daemon: whether it is serving, whether authentication is actually enforced, whether the installed launcher has drifted from the repository, and which arrangement each assistant is configured for.

name: mempalace:stop
desc: Restart the shared MemPalace MCP HTTP daemon. Under the supervisor a stop IS a restart request — to end the daemon, use mempalace:uninstall-daemon.

name: mempalace:switch-http
desc: Switch every supported assistant on this machine to the shared MemPalace MCP HTTP daemon, so concurrent sessions all write to shared memory (spec 0113). All-or-nothing: if one assistant cannot be switched, none is.

name: mempalace:uninstall-daemon
desc: End the shared MemPalace MCP HTTP daemon and remove its supervisor unit. Run this BEFORE reverting the ticket that introduced it — the launcher lives outside the repository, so a revert alone would leave a unit that keeps autostarting.

Usage: task usage:attribute -- add (--session <id> | --agent <id> --parent <id> | --period <YYYY-MM>) (--task-key <key> | --asset <kind>:<ref>) --reason <text> | list | explain --record <id> --cli <cli> --period <YYYY-MM>

name: usage:dashboard

Usage: task usage:dashboard -- [--session <id> | --agent <id> --parent <id> | --task-key <key> | --asset <kind>:<ref> | --cli <cli>] [--from <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--to <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--period <YYYY-MM>] [--model <id>] [--bucket day|week|month] [--currency <ISO4217>] [--as-of-today] [--out <path>]

name: usage:dashboard:report
desc: Print the usage dashboard as a plain-text report, or its view model as JSON (spec 0210 form C). Usage: task usage:dashboard:report -- [same filters as usage:dashboard] [--as-of-today] [--json]

name: usage:dashboard:serve
desc: Serve the live usage dashboard on 127.0.0.1 only, in the foreground (spec 0210 form B); stop it with Ctrl-C or its Stop action. Writes nothing. Usage: task usage:dashboard:serve -- [--port <n>] (default 41920; filters are request parameters, e.g. /?period=2026-09)

name: usage:drain
desc: One-shot, unbounded drain of the usage-capture spool into the usage-record journal (spec 0207 R-L). Pays the first-drain cost once, at a time the operator chooses.

name: usage:inventory
desc: Inventory (and, on request, purge) usage-record drawers directly in MemPalace's usage-records room, independent of the local usage root, journal, or mirror markers (spec 0239). Usage: task usage:inventory -- [list] [--wing <name>[,<name>...]] [--cli <cli>] [--period <YYYY-MM>] [--json] | delete [same filters] [--commit [--confirm-count <N>]]

name: usage:mirror
desc: Run the MemPalace catch-up for pending usage-record mirror markers (spec 0207). Usage: task usage:mirror -- [--reconcile]

name: usage:price
desc: Compute comparative reference prices for usage records against a pinned LiteLLM snapshot (spec 0209). Never an invoice. Usage: task usage:price -- --period <YYYY-MM> [--cli <cli>] [--currency <ISO4217>] [--as-of-today] [--rollup] | --refresh-pricelist [--sha <sha>] | --refresh-fx [--fx-mirror frankfurter] | --cross-check <modelId>

name: usage:prune
desc: Remove a period's usage-record journal entries and mirrored drawers together (spec 0207). Never automatic. Usage: task usage:prune -- <cli> <YYYY-MM> [--force | --unprune]

name: usage:query
desc: Read usage records by session, agent+parent, period, task-handoff key, or external asset reference (spec 0207/0208). JSONL output. Usage: task usage:query -- --session <id> | --period <YYYY-MM> [--cli <cli>] | --task-key <key> [--rollup [--combined]] | ...

name: usage:task
desc: Write, read, or clear the current session's usage-attribution declaration record (spec 0208). Usage: task usage:task -- set --channel explicit|protocol [--task-key <key>] [--asset <kind>:<ref>] | show | clear
